I printed what you sent. Here's how it came out:
knob:
- 5.10 mm pocket: I can't tell you how that one came out.
fit_coupon:
- 5.10 mm pocket: I can't tell you how that one came out.

Send me the design again with submit_design, changed or unchanged, and I'll print it again from what you send.

I’ll resend it unchanged, since there’s no fit result to guide an adjustment. The 5.10 mm dimension is the opening between the retaining catches; the hex pocket itself is 5.80 mm across flats. Please test the coupon first for hand insertion and upside-down retention.

{"note":"Unchanged geometry: there was no usable fit result to justify changing tolerances. The relaxed retaining-catch opening is 5.10 mm across opposing flat locations; the hex socket is 5.80 mm across flats. Finished assembly is one printed knob plus one ISO 4032 M3 nut. The coupon is only a preliminary test. Nominal hardware dimensions are used; successful hand insertion and retention must be confirmed on the coupon.","questions":[{"text":"Actual nut across-flats width and thickness?","answer":"Unable to measure; use best judgment."},{"text":"Did the first prints accept and retain the nut?","answer":"No usable fit result supplied for either print."}],"params":{"nut_af":{"value":5.5,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"nut_height":{"value":2.4,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"bolt_d":{"value":3,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"bolt_pitch":{"value":0.5,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"knob_d":{"value":20,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"knob_h":{"value":8,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"floor_z":{"value":4,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"Nut seating plane above the bed."},"hex_af_clearance":{"value":0.3,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"Total across-flats clearance, not per side; socket AF is 5.80 mm."},"bolt_d_clearance":{"value":0.5,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"Total diametral clearance."},"spring_base_z":{"value":0.8,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"spring_width":{"value":1.8,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"spring_thickness":{"value":0.6,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"spring_gap":{"value":0.8,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"relief_overlap":{"value":0.1,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"catch_interference":{"value":0.2,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"Radial overlap with a nominal nut flat. Twice the tip radius is 5.10 mm, not the hex socket size."},"catch_axial_clearance":{"value":0.15,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"catch_land_h":{"value":0.25,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"catch_ramp_h":{"value":0.7,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"grip_count":{"value":12,"unit":"count","kind":"design","source":"design"},"grip_cut_r":{"value":1.2,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"grip_cut_offset":{"value":0.6,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"Scallop centres lie this distance outside the knob's nominal radius."},"coupon_d":{"value":12,"kind":"design","source":"design"}},"parts":[{"id":"knob","role":"final","material":"PLA","code":"def build(p):
    import math
    af = p.nut_af + p.hex_af_clearance
    flat = af / 2
    outer = flat + p.spring_thickness
    tip = p.nut_af / 2 - p.catch_interference
    lip_z = p.floor_z + p.nut_height + p.catch_axial_clearance
    top_z = lip_z + p.catch_land_h + p.catch_ramp_h
    body = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.knob_d/2).extrude(p.knob_h)
    for i in range(int(p.grip_count)):
        a = 2*math.pi*i/p.grip_count
        r = p.knob_d/2 + p.grip_cut_offset
        cut = cq.Workplane('XY').center(r*math.cos(a),r*math.sin(a)).circle(p.grip_cut_r).extrude(p.knob_h)
        body = body.cut(cut)
    pocket = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.floor_z).polygon(6,2*af/math.sqrt(3)).extrude(p.knob_h-p.floor_z)
    body = body.cut(pocket)
    body = body.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').circle((p.bolt_d+p.bolt_d_clearance)/2).extrude(p.knob_h))
    inner = flat-p.relief_overlap
    relief_outer = outer+p.spring_gap
    relief = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.spring_base_z).center(0,(inner+relief_outer)/2).rect(p.spring_width+2*p.spring_gap,relief_outer-inner).extrude(p.knob_h-p.spring_base_z)
    profile = [(flat,p.spring_base_z),(outer,p.spring_base_z),(outer,top_z),(flat,top_z),(tip,lip_z+p.catch_land_h),(tip,lip_z),(flat,lip_z)]
    finger = cq.Workplane('YZ').polyline(profile).close().extrude(p.spring_width).translate((-p.spring_width/2,0,0))
    for a in (0,120,240):
        body = body.cut(relief.rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),a))
    for a in (0,120,240):
        body = body.union(finger.rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),a))
    return body.clean()
","print_orientation":"Broad flat underside on bed at z=0; hex opening and spring ramps upward. No supports.","use_orientation":"Nut enters the top opening along -Z, seats at z=floor_z, and is retained below the three catches. Bolt passes along the central Z axis."},{"id":"fit_coupon","role":"coupon","material":"PLA","code":"def build(p):
    import math
    af = p.nut_af + p.hex_af_clearance
    flat = af/2
    outer = flat+p.spring_thickness
    tip = p.nut_af/2-p.catch_interference
    lip_z = p.floor_z+p.nut_height+p.catch_axial_clearance
    top_z = lip_z+p.catch_land_h+p.catch_ramp_h
    body = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.coupon_d/2).extrude(p.knob_h)
    body = body.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.floor_z).polygon(6,2*af/math.sqrt(3)).extrude(p.knob_h-p.floor_z))
    body = body.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').circle((p.bolt_d+p.bolt_d_clearance)/2).extrude(p.knob_h))
    inner = flat-p.relief_overlap
    relief_outer = outer+p.spring_gap
    relief = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.spring_base_z).center(0,(inner+relief_outer)/2).rect(p.spring_width+2*p.spring_gap,relief_outer-inner).extrude(p.knob_h-p.spring_base_z)
    profile = [(flat,p.spring_base_z),(outer,p.spring_base_z),(outer,top_z),(flat,top_z),(tip,lip_z+p.catch_land_h),(tip,lip_z),(flat,lip_z)]
    finger = cq.Workplane('YZ').polyline(profile).close().extrude(p.spring_width).translate((-p.spring_width/2,0,0))
    for a in (0,120,240):
        body = body.cut(relief.rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),a))
    for a in (0,120,240):
        body = body.union(finger.rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),a))
    return body.clean()
","print_orientation":"Flat underside on bed at z=0, opening upward. Same settings as the final knob; no supports.","use_orientation":"Test nut seating, hand insertion and retention exactly as on the final knob."}],"hardware":[{"id":"nut","ref":"ISO 4032 M3","qty":1}],"criteria":[{"id":"hand_insertion","part":"knob","feature":"Hex socket and three ramped spring catches","relation":"contains","hardware":"nut","params":["nut_af","nut_height","hex_af_clearance","spring_width","spring_thickness","spring_gap","spring_base_z","catch_interference"],"check":{"method":"coupon","ref":"fit_coupon","description":"Align nut flats and press fully home with a thumb. It must seat without tools, cracks, or spring whitening. Springs must return inward after insertion."}},{"id":"upside_down_retention","part":"knob","feature":"Three catch undersides above seated nut","relation":"engages","hardware":"nut","params":["catch_interference","catch_axial_clearance","catch_land_h","floor_z","nut_height"],"check":{"method":"coupon","ref":"fit_coupon","description":"Invert and gently tap the coupon's side. Nut must stay captive; slight axial play is acceptable. Verify that catches overlap the top of the nut."}},{"id":"fully_recessed","part":"knob","feature":"Nut seating plane below top rim","relation":"contains","hardware":"nut","params":["floor_z","nut_height","knob_h"],"check":{"method":"coupon","ref":"fit_coupon","description":"Nut must sit flat and entirely below the top rim."}},{"id":"bottom_stop","part":"knob","feature":"Solid seating shoulder surrounding central bore","relation":"supports","hardware":"nut","params":["floor_z","bolt_d","bolt_d_clearance","nut_af","spring_base_z"],"check":{"method":"coupon","ref":"fit_coupon","description":"Press the seated nut with a thumb; it must not pass through the underside. Do not jack against the floor using a bolt."}},{"id":"bolt_passage","part":"knob","feature":"Central clearance bore","relation":"clears","clearance_mm":0.25,"params":["bolt_d","bolt_d_clearance"],"check":{"method":"coupon","ref":"fit_coupon","description":"Hand-thread your M3 bolt through the seated nut; verify its tip emerges freely through the opposite face without contacting plastic."}},{"id":"torque_transfer","part":"knob","feature":"Hex walls, especially the three uninterrupted flats","relation":"engages","hardware":"nut","params":["nut_af","hex_af_clearance","nut_height"],"check":{"method":"coupon","ref":"fit_coupon","description":"With the nut threaded onto your bolt, apply light finger torque. Nut must turn with the coupon, not spin within the socket."}}],"manual":[{"n":"1","text":"Print fit_coupon first using PLA, the supplied orientation, a 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layers, four walls, and 100% infill. Use normal or reduced outer-wall speed for the small springs. Disable supports and keep brim material out of the spring slots.","parts":["fit_coupon"]},{"n":"2","text":"Allow it to cool and remove loose strings from the socket and spring slots. Align the nut flats with the hex socket and thumb-press it straight down until seated beneath the catches. Do not hammer, heat, or draw it into place using a bolt. The 5.10 mm retaining opening is intentionally smaller than the nut; the spring ramps must deflect during insertion.","parts":["fit_coupon"],"hardware":["nut"]},{"n":"3","text":"Check that the nut is flat and fully recessed, springs have returned inward, and the nut stays captive when inverted and gently tapped. Hand-thread your M3 bolt through the nut and out the opposite face. Check that light finger torque turns the nut with the coupon rather than spinning it in the socket. Do not proceed if any check fails.","parts":["fit_coupon"],"hardware":["nut"]},{"n":"4","text":"If the hex walls bind, increase hex_af_clearance by 0.1 mm. If only the catches make insertion too stiff, decrease catch_interference by 0.05 mm. If the nut falls out after the springs return, increase catch_interference by 0.05 mm. Reprint and repeat all checks after any change. Discard cracked or whitened samples; do not force assembly.","parts":["fit_coupon"],"hardware":["nut"]},{"n":"5","text":"Print knob using the validated parameters and identical settings. The coupon is not part of the final assembly. If your only nut is in the coupon, carefully flex the catches outward to retrieve it without damaging the nut.","parts":["knob","fit_coupon"],"hardware":["nut"]},{"n":"6","text":"After cooling and clearing strings, press the nut into knob by hand. Repeat the retention and bolt-passage checks. Finished assembly is one printed piece with one captive nut, without glue or additional retaining hardware.","parts":["knob"],"hardware":["nut"]},{"n":"7","text":"Thread onto your M3 bolt by hand and use finger tightening only. The socket walls carry torque; the floor supports load toward the underside. Spring catches provide handling retention, not structural restraint against axial pull toward the opening. Avoid heat, high clamp loads and pliers. Stop use if springs crack or the nut spins.","parts":["knob"],"hardware":["nut"]}]}
